meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 先扫描项目里没被引用的代码,用 LSP 引用查询确认,再派并行子代理按文件分批删除;每批通过类型检查后才单独提交,最后给出删除清单和类型检查/测试/构建结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup”等关键词时触发;也可以指定文件、目录或符号名,把扫描范围缩小到那一个目标。

say.text: 扫描这个项目的死代码,确认后再删除
say.note: 会先列出候选清单,再做 LSP 验证

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下没被引用的代码
say.note: 扫描范围限定在该目录

say.text: 把 src/foo.ts 里未使用的导入和函数删掉
say.note: 每个文件一批,类型检查通过才提交

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude scans the project for unreferenced code, confirms each candidate with LSP reference lookups, then dispatches parallel sub-agents to remove dead code file-by-file. Each batch is committed only after typecheck passes, ending with a removal list and typecheck/test/build results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “remove dead code”, “dead code”, or “cleanup”, etc.; you can also pass a file, directory, or symbol name to narrow the scan to that target.

say_en.text: Scan this project for dead code, confirm, then remove it
say_en.note: Lists candidates first, then verifies with LSP

say_en.text: Only clean unreferenced code under src/utils
say_en.note: Narrows the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Remove unused imports and functions in src/foo.ts
say_en.note: One batch per file, committed after typecheck passes
